name: WebBench
notes: The README and dataset card describe 2,454 tasks on 452 websites (category counts summing to 2,454) and an expanded pool of 5,750 tasks. The released webbenchfinal.csv has 2,647 rows with unique IDs and 453 distinct starting URLs, so the released file and the documented total differ. Tasks run on live third-party websites, so content, logins and anti-bot measures change over time. The repository holds the task CSVs and per-agent result files but no evaluation harness; the README points to the leaderboard and technical report for methodology. The Hugging Face dataset card declares MIT for the task data; the repository LICENSE is MIT for the repository. Website content and account requirements belong to the target sites.
summary: Live-web benchmark from Halluminate and Skyvern with read, create, update, delete and file-download tasks on 452 high-traffic websites, including logins and form entry, with released per-agent run results.
